notes.subject: ol pasin tsedek
notes.rationale: צדקות kept as 'tsedek' per discipline; abstract plural 'righteousnesses' rendered as 'ol pasin tsedek'.

notes.subject: i sekim
notes.rationale: נער literally 'shake out/ shake off' — the hands are shaken free of a bribe, like dust.

notes.subject: harim toktok bilong kapsait blut
notes.rationale: 'Hearing of blood' = listening to plans of murder or testimony about bloodshed; rendered literally with clarifying addition.

notes.subject: answer to v14
notes.rationale: Verse implicitly answers the question of v14: this is the one who may dwell with the fire.

translation: Man i wokabaut long ol pasin tsedek, na i toktok stret; i les long lukautim ol kago bilong ol man i use-strong-long narapela man; i sekim ol han bilong em long holim sokong; i tapim aring bilong em long harim toktok bilong kapsait blut; na i tapim ai bilong em long lukim ol samting nogut —

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man i use-strong-long narapela man
